We can arrange shipping.

The winning bidder is responsible for all shipping and handling costs, which will be added to the final GovDeals invoice.

We DO NOT accept shipping labels for smaller lot(s) or customer-arranged freight for larger lot(s) from winning bidders due to a past issue with a previous bidder.

Please DO NOT show up to pick up your lot(s) or to inspect without an appointment. You will be denied access to our facilities and asked to schedule an appointment. To schedule an appointment please call our office 220-238-2313.

Deeply Discounted Premium Lot – 0.27 Acres – Utilities at the Street – High-End Surroundings – Incredible Investment Upside

Welcome to one of the most desirable residential parcels in all of Holiday Island. Located in Unit 5 and surrounded by high-value, beautifully built homes, this 0.270-acre lot offers the perfect balance of privacy, proximity to the lake, and access to all of the premium Holiday Island amenities.

📍 Location: Hickory Ln, Holiday Island, AR 72631

2 Golf Courses – 18-hole championship course + 9-hole executive course

2 Lakes – Table Rock Lake and Holiday Island Marina for boating, fishing, kayaking, and swimming

Full-Service Marina with boat slips, gas, and ramp access

Swimming Pools – Two outdoor pools with lounge areas

Tennis, Pickleball, & Basketball Courts

Softball Field & Mini-Golf

Recreation Center – Event spaces, fitness room, and game room

RV Park & Campground for residents and guests

Hiking Trails and wildlife observation

Security & Maintenance Services provided by HISID staff year-round

🧾 HOA Fee (2025): ~$570/year for vacant landowners
Includes access to all listed amenities

🔥 Why Invest in Holiday Island?

Holiday Island is a fast-growing lakeside community nestled in the heart of the Ozarks, just minutes from Eureka Springs and a short drive to Branson, Missouri. It’s a magnet for:

Retirees seeking peaceful upscale living

Outdoor enthusiasts looking for year-round lake and trail access

Savvy investors targeting buildable lots in appreciating areas

📍 Right next to Fayetteville and the booming Northwest Arkansas region.

Lot 102 Maple Ln (0.25 acres) – Sold for $21,500 in 2023

Lot 124 Holiday Island Dr (0.28 acres) – Listed for $26,000

💰 Our Lot Priced Well Below Market for Fast Sale

📈 Why Northwest Arkansas (NWA) is BOOMING

Northwest Arkansas is one of the fastest-growing regions in the United States, driven by:

Headquarters of Walmart, Tyson Foods, and J.B. Hunt

Major university presence (University of Arkansas)

A growing startup and tech scene

Regional infrastructure expansion (I-49 corridor, XNA airport)

World-class quality of life (Crystal Bridges Museum, Walmart AMP, mountain biking trails)

Forbes: NWA Is the Heart of the Heartland

Talk Business: NWA Population Growth Outpaces Most of the U.S.

Whether you’re looking to build now or hold for future appreciation, this premium oversized parcel is a smart acquisition. Nestled among luxury homes, with full utility access and priced well below market, this lot offers strong upside in a rapidly appreciating market.

8VAC20-70-500. Sale of surplus school buses.
A. Before a surplus school bus is sold or released for non-school transportation purposes, the bus shall have the traffic
warning signal system and crossing control arm removed and all school bus lettering shall be covered by an opaque

Virginia.

that the bus shall be painted a different color, and shall have the bus signal systems and lettering removed before
release for non-school transportation purposes.

3337-7807.assetLongDesc:
CSU Surplus Property is selling a 2000 Motor Coach Industries 102-CL3 55-Passenger Bus that was previously used in a university setting. Latent mechanical defects may be present that we are unaware of and unable to verify. It is highly encouraged that bidders inspect vehicles in person prior to placing a bid. Maintenance records are not available for review.

Year: 2000

Make: MCI

Model: 102-DL3

VIN: 1M8PDMPA8YP052571

Mileage: 696117

Title: Has title, no restrictions

Specs:

For sale from site, buyer/associate MUST remove – ideally with valid CDL license.

Individuals may inspect or load out this item BY APPOINTMENT ONLY. All interested parties must notify CSU Surplus 24 HOURS in advance to be accompanied by an authorized personnel member to the offsite location. Local pickup ONLY.

LOAD OUT ASSISTANCE NOT PROVIDED for this item. Please contact CSU Surplus for more information.

This vehicle is equipped with a 12.7 L V6 Detroit diesel engine Series 60 that starts and runs (powers on, no further testing) as of 8/5/25, and is NOT DOT Compliant. The bus has front-wheel drive and an automatic transmission that is operable as of 8/5/25.

The 45ft long exterior is white with minor dents, scratches, and dings throughout. There is no cracked glass present. No major damage is present beyond normal wear and tear. Decals have been removed but impressions remain. There are 8 tires. All are inflated with OK tread (see photos) as of 8/5/25.

Tire size (all): 315/80 R 22.5

There is no accessory emergency equipment present. Storage for luggage/equipment is located on either side of vehicle exterior with spare tire compartment behind front grill.

The interior is blue with cloth seats. The headliner is in-tact and the overhead compartments are in good condition, with minor wear and tears. The seats are in good condition. Each seat has the ability to recline, has a footrest, and has an arm rest that can be put up or fold down. Most seats have a cup holder, although some are broken or missing. There are multiple TVs mounted to the ceiling (functionality unknown), sun block screens that roll down, and a bathroom located at the back of the bus for additional travel comfort.

The AC is missing compressor and is not functional. The center component of the steering wheel is missing.

This vehicle is equipped with an AM/FM CD radio, reported functional at time of retirement, cruise control, tilt steering, power steering, and an air-powered front seat.

Spare tire is located at front of vehicle, and there is no jack present.

Vehicle is sold as is appears in all photos.

See photos for more information and specifications.

*Only the item(s) described herein are included in the sale regardless of what else is
pictured.*

Under no circumstances will the Seller or Georgia State Employees assume responsibility for packing, loading or shipping.

If Seller’s property or facilities are damaged during loading and removal of items, Buyer will not be allowed to complete removal of purchased items until the Seller’s property and facilities have been repaired. If the Buyer does not repair the damaged Seller property and facilities, any payment made by the Buyer will be applied to the repair of Seller property before being applied to the purchase price of any items purchased by Buyer.

• Property not removed on the selected date will be considered abandoned, buyer is declared in default, and ownership shall revert to the Seller. The Seller will only refund according to the default provision. For additional information, contact Georgia State Surplus, office (404) 657-8544, Option #2 – fax (404) 463-2912 or e-mail: Public.SurplusSales@doas.ga.gov

357-50603.removalInstructions:
Purchases will be released only upon receipt of State of Georgia Bill of Sale.

• Property must be removed by appointment only. Within the next 24-48 business hours after receiving the Bill of Sale you should receive an invitation to schedule pickup. You will have 5 business days identified by the releasing agency from which to select a date and time for the removal of the items. All items must be removed on the selected date. You will receive an email confirming your scheduled date and time for removal.

• Successful Buyer is responsible for all loading and removal of any and all property awarded to them from the location indicated in the auction listing. The Buyer will make all arrangements and perform all work necessary, including packing, loading and transportation of the property. Under no circumstances will the Seller or Georgia State Employees assume responsibility for packing, loading or shipping.

• The Buyer is responsible for all damage to Seller’s property and facilities caused during the packing, loading and removal of items. If Seller’s property or facilities are damaged during loading and removal of items, Buyer will not be allowed to complete removal of purchased items until the Seller’s property and facilities have been repaired. If the Buyer does not repair the damaged Seller property and facilities, any payment made by the Buyer will be applied to the repair of Seller property before being applied to the purchase price of any items purchased by Buyer.

• Property not removed on the selected date will be considered abandoned, buyer is declared in default, and ownership shall revert to the Seller. The Seller will only refund according to the default provision.
